## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Tarazona, Spain. It starts at Carretera Virgen del Yugo, s/n.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Get online tickets to Sendaviva and enjoy stress-free access to the Nature Park of Navarra, one of the largest of its kind in the north of Spain. Sendaviva has all the ingredients to spend a family day full of fun and nature with a perfect mix of attractions, animals and shows.
>
> With over 30 attractions, Sendaviva has rides for all ages and preferences: play, learn, feel the adrenaline, get soaked and much more! In addition, enjoy the 5 interactive shows available inside the park, including a circus, a puppet show, and one of the most famous interactive bird experiences in Europe.
>
> Finally, see how more than 800 animals live amid nature inside the park and book tickets for special activities like Small Scientists or Zoorprising World to make the most of your experience.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €34.00. It was rated 4.4 out of 5 from 555 ratings and 271 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
